Seashore Group of Hotels | About Us
About Us
Our Mission
We plan to make a difference in the lives of every individual we touch, be it, customers, employees, or partners by upholding a strong moral system and being a responsible participant in the community.
Our Vision
We aim to become the number one hotel in the whole of South Tamil Nadu and be amongst the most admired hospitality brand across South India.
Our Experience
We are now a group of over 20 hotels and several multi-cuisine restaurants in South Tamil Nadu, with 7 hotels and 3 restaurants in Kanyakumari alone.
About The Seashore Group
The Seashore Group started as a single hotel in Kanyakumari in 1968 by Mr. G. Mani. From humble beginnings as a taxi driver, Mr. Mani put his heart and soul into this venture, to grow into a leading name in the hospitality industry in South Tamil Nadu. Today, the group has grown to include more than 20 hotels and several multi-cuisine restaurants in and around Kanyakumari. It has passed on the current generation who has taken the Seashore Group to the next level. We take pride in creating an unsurpassed vacation and leisure experience for all our customers. From delectable cuisine, travel assistance and customized stay, we go the extra mile to make your stay memorable and provide you with the best holiday experience ever.

Suite rooms at Sahana Castle include a living room and bedroom, each of which is well decorated and elegantly furnished with luxurious furniture and fixtures. All our executive and suite rooms are spacious, well-lit, and guaranteed to make your stay pleasant. They also come with a large workstation with an executive table and desk lamp. Among other amenities, the suite room includes a bath shower, flat-screen TV with access to international and national channels, Wi-Fi, high-speed internet access, and 24-hour room service.
